claim: On binarized MNIST (784 dimensions), the method achieves R2 = 0.86 in 15 minutes using 10000 basis elements.
falsification_margin: All seeds must be outside [0.845, 0.875) in R2 or outside [0.0025, 0.03) in MSE.
timing_policy: Report timing but do not decide the 15-minute subclaim on different hardware.
